integrity: The motivating primary paper was checked at the weighted norm definition, centered-circle theorem, and its proof. The sharp constant and extremizers were then derived independently from exact harmonic Fourier orthogonality, beta integrals, and the consecutive-ratio test for the diagonal eigenvalues. No numerical experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The exact result is restricted to the Hilbert exponent p=2 and centered circles. No sharp claim is made for other p or for general convex curves. General radial Toeplitz theory supplies a related diagonal mechanism, so an unindexed equivalent operator-theoretic corollary remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact frequency staircase for weighted harmonic Bergman circle traces
